data.description: 放学后学生会室，她把收据按日期排开贴进账本，动作精准得像机器；其他成员离开后，她对着平掉的账目轻轻舒一口气，露出小小的成就感。
data.promptProse: Kei Shirogane arranges receipts by date and pastes them into the student council ledger after the others have left. Her dark school uniform, white collar and black headband remain neat as she exhales with a small satisfied smile. The medium view includes the emptied chairs around the working table. Afternoon window light illuminates paper corners and her fingertips, leaving separate receipt shadows on the ledger and a quieter shaded wall behind.
data.title: 白银圭 · 初中部学生会的决算
